newsitem.title: USA: Med/Waste to buy USA Waste unit.
newsitem.headline: Med/Waste to buy USA Waste unit.

text.p: Med/Waste Inc said on Friday it agreed to acquire the incineration facility owned by USA Waste Services Inc's Chambers Medical.
The purchase price was not disclosed.

The facility, located in Hampton, S.C., provides waste management and disposal services for non-hazardous medical and special waste customers primarily in the Eastern United States market, the company said.
Med-Waste said the facility is a waste-to-energy facility capable of processing 270 tons of special and medical waste per day.
